title: Wonders Grade 3 – Lesson 5: A Mountain of History

mountain.d: a very big, very tall hill
mountain.ex: We climbed a mountain with Dad.

history.d: things that happened a long time ago
history.ex: Grandpa tells me stories about history.

rushmore.d: a big mountain in America with the faces of four presidents cut into the rock
rushmore.ex: Mount Rushmore is in South Dakota.

honors.d: to show that you think someone is very important and good
honors.ex: Our school honors the best helpers with a party.

special.d: not like the others; very important to you
special.ex: My birthday is a special day.

usa.d: a big country in North America; it is also called America
usa.ex: My cousin lives in the United States.

presidents.ex: The president gives a speech to the people.

washington.d: the first president of the United States, about 230 years ago
washington.ex: George Washington is the first face on Mount Rushmore.

jefferson.d: the third president of the United States; he helped the country grow bigger
jefferson.ex: Thomas Jefferson is the second face on Mount Rushmore.

roosevelt.d: the 26th president of the United States; he saved land for parks
roosevelt.ex: Theodore Roosevelt has glasses and a mustache on Mount Rushmore.

lincoln.d: the 16th president of the United States; he ended slavery and kept the country together
lincoln.ex: Abraham Lincoln has a beard on Mount Rushmore.

essential.d: very, very important; you really need it

question.d: something you ask to find out an answer
question.ex: I ask my teacher a question.

landmark.d: a famous place or building that is easy to see and remember
landmark.ex: The tall tower is a landmark in our city.

help.d: to make something easier for someone
help.ex: I help Mom carry the bags.

understand.ex: Now I understand the math problem!

country.d: a land with its own people, leader and flag

story.ex: Mom reads me a story at night.

read.d: to look at words and understand them
read.ex: I read a book every day.

national.d: of a whole country; for all the people of a country
national.ex: We watch fireworks on National Day.

memorial.d: a place or thing that helps people remember a person or a big event
memorial.ex: We put flowers at the memorial.

find_out.ex: Let's find out what is in the box!

find.d: to see something you were looking for
find.ex: I can't find my other shoe!

people.ex: Many people are at the park.

visit.d: to go to see a place or a person

all_over.ex: Kids from all over the city came to the show.

dakota.d: a state (a part) of the United States, in the middle of the country
dakota.ex: Mount Rushmore is in South Dakota.

monument.d: a big statue or building made so people remember someone or something important
monument.ex: There is a monument to a hero in the park.

year.d: twelve months; the time from one birthday to the next

millions.ex: There are millions of stars in the sky.

travel.d: to go to a place that is far away
travel.ex: We travel by plane to see Grandpa.

black_hills.d: a group of dark, tree-covered mountains in South Dakota
black_hills.ex: Mount Rushmore is in the Black Hills.

heads.d: the top part of the body, with the face and hair
heads.ex: I wear a hat on my head.

carved.d: cut wood or stone to make a shape (carve, carved)
carved.ex: Grandpa carved a little bird out of wood.

carve.d: to cut wood or stone to make a shape
carve.ex: The workers carve the stone with tools.

side.d: the left or right part of something, not the top or bottom
side.ex: There is a little house on the side of the hill.

treasure.d: something very special that people want to keep safe
treasure.ex: The pirate found a box of treasure.

birth.d: the time when someone is born or something begins
birth.ex: The birth of my baby sister made us so happy.

artist.d: a person who makes art, like paintings or statues
artist.ex: The artist paints a picture of the sea.

named.ex: I have a dog named Lucky.

borglum.d: the artist who planned Mount Rushmore
borglum.ex: Gutzon Borglum made small models of the faces first.

designed.d: to make a plan or drawing of how something will look

ago.ex: I lost my tooth two days ago.

long_ago.d: a lot of time before now
long_ago.ex: Long ago, people had no phones.

symbol.d: a picture or thing that stands for an idea
symbol.ex: A heart is a symbol of love.

qualities.d: a good thing about a person, like being kind or brave
qualities.ex: Being kind is one of her best qualities.

led.d: showed the way; was in charge of a group
led.ex: The teacher led the children to the park.

new.d: just made or just started; not old

nation.d: a country and all its people
nation.ex: The whole nation watched the big game.

slavery.d: when some people were owned by other people and made to work with no pay; it was very wrong
slavery.ex: Abraham Lincoln worked to end slavery.

kept.d: to make something stay the same
kept.ex: I kept my room clean all week.

during.ex: We are quiet during the movie.

civil_war.d: a war between two groups in the same country; in America it ended about 160 years ago
civil_war.ex: The Civil War was a sad time in America.

saved.d: to keep something safe from harm

land.d: the ground; an area of earth
land.ex: The farmer has a lot of land.

parks.d: a big green place where people walk and play
parks.ex: We play in the park after school.

leaders.d: a person who is in charge of a group
leaders.ex: Our team leader holds the flag.

stand_for.d: to mean; to show an idea
stand_for.ex: A red light stands for stop.

first.d: number one; before all the others
first.ex: I was first in the race!

answer.d: what you say back to a question

reread.ex: Reread the page if it is hard.

stone.ex: I found a smooth stone at the beach.

workers.d: a person who does a job
workers.ex: The workers are building a new school.

faces.d: the front of the head, with eyes, nose and mouth
faces.ex: She has paint on her face.

job.ex: My job at home is to feed the cat.

models.d: a small copy of something bigger
models.ex: I built a model of a plane.

used.d: did something with a thing to help you
used.ex: I used scissors to cut the paper.

guide.d: to show someone where to go or what to do
guide.ex: Mom guides me across the street.

dynamite.d: a very strong thing that explodes (goes BOOM!) to break big rocks; only experts use it
dynamite.ex: The workers used dynamite to break the rock.

carefully.d: slowly and with care so nothing goes wrong

blast.d: to break apart with a big explosion
blast.ex: Workers blast rock to make a new road.

away.d: from this place to another place

rock.ex: I sat on a big rock.

tools.d: a thing you hold to help you do work, like a hammer
tools.ex: Dad keeps his tools in a box.

worked.ex: Mom worked in the garden all day.

finish.d: to do the last part of something
finish.ex: I finish my homework before dinner.

grand.ex: The Forbidden City is grand and beautiful.

sculpture.d: art made by cutting or shaping stone, wood or clay
sculpture.ex: We saw a sculpture of a horse at the museum.

cost.d: to have a price; to need money to buy
cost.ex: The ice cream cost five yuan.

almost.ex: I am almost as tall as my brother.

dollars.d: money used in the United States

think.d: to use your mind to have ideas

feet.d: a way to measure how long or tall something is; 1 foot is about 30 cm
feet.ex: The tree is twenty feet tall.

floor.ex: This apartment building has four floors.

building.d: a house, school, or other place with walls and a roof
building.ex: Our school is a big building.

noses.d: the part of your face you smell with
noses.ex: I smell the flowers with my nose.

long.d: far from one end to the other

mouths.d: the part of your face you eat and talk with

wide.d: far from one side to the other

climb.d: to go up using your hands and feet
climb.ex: I climb the ladder to the slide.

above.ex: The bird flies above the trees.

ground.d: the top of the earth that you walk on outside
ground.ex: The leaves fell to the ground.

native_american.d: the first people who lived in America, long before other people came
native_american.ex: Native Americans lived in the Black Hills long ago.

lived.d: had your home in a place
lived.ex: My grandma lived in a small village.

built.d: to make something by putting parts together
built.ex: We built a tower with blocks.

place.ex: The park is my favorite place.

learn.d: to get to know something new
learn.ex: I learn new words at school.

reason.d: why something happens; "for this reason" means "because of this"
reason.ex: The reason I am happy is my new puppy.

includes.d: to have something as one part
includes.ex: My lunch box includes an apple.

heritage.d: the old ways, stories and things a family or group keeps from long ago
heritage.ex: Making dumplings is part of our family heritage.

village.ex: My grandpa lives in a village by a river.

visitors.d: a person who comes to see a place or a person
visitors.ex: Many visitors come to the zoo.

see.d: to use your eyes to know something is there

tepees.d: a tent shaped like a cone, made of long poles and animal skins; some Native Americans lived in them
tepees.ex: We saw a tepee at the museum.

traces.d: small signs that show someone or something was there
traces.ex: We found traces of a dog in the snow.

life.ex: Life in a village is quiet.

gives.ex: I give my friend a gift.

clues.d: a thing that helps you find an answer
clues.ex: The muddy footprints are a clue.

past.ex: In the past, people rode horses to town.

teaches.ex: My teacher teaches me to read.

culture.d: the food, clothes, music, art and ways of a group of people
culture.ex: The dragon dance is part of Chinese culture.

discover.d: to find or learn something new
discover.ex: We discovered a shell on the beach.

facts.ex: It is a fact that fish live in water.

summer.d: the hottest time of the year

park_rangers.d: a person who takes care of a park and teaches visitors about it
park_rangers.ex: The park ranger showed us a bird's nest.

museum.d: a building where you can see old or special things
museum.ex: We saw dinosaur bones at the museum.

studio.d: a room where an artist works
studio.ex: The painter works in her studio.

reminds.ex: Mom reminds me to brush my teeth.

text.d: written words, like in a book
text.ex: Read the text and answer the questions.

details.ex: Look at the details in the picture.

selection.d: a story or text that someone chose for you to read
selection.ex: Our reading selection today is about bees.

summarize.d: to tell only the most important parts in a few words
summarize.ex: Can you summarize the movie in one sentence?

good.d: nice; the way it should be

title.d: the name of a book, story or movie
title.ex: The title is on the cover of the book.

many.ex: There are many fish in the pond.
